items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: I took some lessons from Professor Dickinson.

ctx.x: Yeah, did you ever take any lessons from anybody else?

Well, I took some lessons from Professor Dickinson. Yeah, I know you told me, but- A few lessons from him. Did you take lessons from any well-known? No, no. Maurice Duran was the one that coached me the most with the trophy.
This reminds me, did you ever go to the alley? Yeah, it was over here.
